hooks.name: relay-session-start
hooks.description: Point the agent at AGENTS.md and the handoff on session start.

action.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .ai/HANDOFF.md. If .ai/ still has placeholders, run the plug-and-play bootstrap from AGENTS.md before doing anything else.

hooks.name: relay-checkpoint
hooks.description: Remind the agent to run the checkpoint when it stops.

action.prompt: [ai-agent-relay] turn finished: if you reached a meaningful checkpoint, run .ai/workflows/checkpoint.md (commit or list WIP, update the Resume block in .ai/HANDOFF.md, honor .ai/LIMITS.md).
